# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Name, section and email in columns, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students for contact sheet")
    for stud in students:
        if not stud.email:
            raise ValueError(f"no email for {stud.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda stud: stud.display_name)
    name_wide = max(len(stud.display_name) for stud in ordered)
    sect_wide = max(len(stud.section) for stud in ordered)
    return [
        f"{stud.display_name:<{name_wide}}  "
        f"{stud.section:<{sect_wide}}  {stud.email}"
        for stud in ordered
    ]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


def make(last, sect, mail):
    return Student("1", last, "Ann", sect, mail)


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Zed", "A", "z@x.org"),
                             make("Bo", "B", "b@x.org")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], "Bo, Ann   B  b@x.org")
        self.assertEqual(rows[1], "Zed, Ann  A  z@x.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Bo, Ann"):
            contact_rows([make("Bo", "A", None)])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF

# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Name, section and email in columns, by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students for contact sheet")
    for stud in students:
        if not stud.email:
            name = stud.display_name
            raise ValueError(f"no email: {name}")
    rows = sorted(
        (stud.display_name, stud.section, stud.email)
        for stud in students
    )
    wide = [
        max(len(row[num]) for row in rows) for num in (0, 1)
    ]
    return [
        f"{name:<{wide[0]}}  {sect:<{wide[1]}}  {mail}"
        for name, sect, mail in rows
    ]
